Gebo — Rune Meaning

← All rune meanings
ᚷ
gift partnership fair exchange connection

Upright meaning

Gebo is all about gifts and fair exchange — and not just material ones. This rune is about the balance of give and take in all your relationships and dealings.

Something good might be coming your way — an opportunity, a genuine offer, or a partnership that's built on mutual respect. Receive it graciously. Refusing a genuine gift isn't noble; it breaks the connection.

The key thing Gebo reminds you of is balance. Real relationships — personal or professional — aren't one-sided. They're about both people showing up and contributing. Where that's happening in your life, honour it.

Gebo doesn't reverse. Once given, a gift changes things permanently.
